qa_flags.detail: Reported CFO contains clearing/customer-fund flows. Ex-clearing cash generation is not unrestricted or fully regulatory-adjusted FCF.
All SBC remains in normalized EBIT; supplemental cash measure deducts SBC rather than treating it as free.
Australia gain excluded; Canada remains pending. No fabricated standalone continuing-business TTM.
Corporate cash proxy is not fully distributable. Foreign cash may be indefinitely reinvested; avoid double counting regulatory capital against a combined reserve.
TTM diluted EPS 14.06 is sum of reported quarters. FY+YTD-minus-priorYTD EPS produces 14.05 due rounding/dilution. Analyst normalized EPS withheld.
Payable $46.9m is working capital, issuer reports zero collected cash. Matching receivable not separately quantified; do not call payable pure corporate debt.
2026 cash purchases label explicitly includes data processing software; full reported purchases line retained in every period. Separate incremental licensing cash fees not disclosed.
